messages:
maya: Customer reports missing span links in Trace Panel for several request IDs after last night's deploy. They say traces show the root request but child spans are absent and the request->trace linking UI shows 'No spans found' for ~10% of requests in the last 24h. Customer provided request_id req_7f3a9b and a screenshot. They say it started around 2026-02-18 03:12 UTC.
support-bot: Ticket #C-4312 created and linked to this thread. Customer severity: high.
oliver: Can you paste the exact request_id and a quick repro curl? Also which dataset / env (prod-us-east)?
maya: prod-us-east. Repro from customer: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello","request_id":"req_7f3a9b"}'``` They say the request appears in request logs but trace view shows root span only.

maya: Customer ran this query in their debug console: ```SELECT * FROM traces WHERE request_id='req_7f3a9b'``` returns a trace row with root_span_id but no child spans.
sre-jun: Noted. We had a router-side retry optimization rolled out at 2026-02-18 02:58 UTC that changed sampler headers; possible header drop between ingress and trace-joiner. Could be race during a slow join.

oliver: Can you run a quick check against the span index for that request_id? e.g.: ```curl -s "https://logstore.internal/api/spans?request_id=req_7f3a9b" | jq .```

maya: Ran that and got an empty array. However request logs show 3 child span emit events around the same time: log excerpt: ```2026-02-18T03:12:01Z INFO span_emit span_id=span_1 parent=span_root request_id=req_7f3a9b
2026-02-18T03:12:02Z INFO span_emit span_id=span_2 parent=span_1 request_id=req_7f3a9b
2026-02-18T03:12:03Z INFO span_emit span_id=span_3 parent=span_2 request_id=req_7f3a9b```

devex-anna: We also had a deploy to trace-joiner at 02:59 UTC with a schema change to the parent_ref field. Rollout was quick but we skipped a canary on prod for that change. I've flagged the deploy and logs show a spike in schema-validation errors for ~15m after deploy.

sre-jun: That matches. If joiner dropped spans due to schema mismatch they would be in request logs but not indexed. Check joiner metrics: `joiner.dropped_spans_total` and `joiner.validation_errors`.
oliver: I grep'd the joiner logs: ```grep req_7f3a9b /var/log/joiner/joiner.log | tail -n 50``` returned nothing for that request, but there are a bunch of validation errors at 03:00-03:15: ```ERROR validation failed: missing parent_ref for span_id=span_*```

maya: Customer updated saying other request_ids from same timeframe similarly missing. They're asking for timeline and mitigation.

sre-jun: Immediate mitigation: enable fallback-accept-legacy-schema on trace-joiner and reprocess the window 2026-02-18T02:50:00Z -> 2026-02-18T03:30:00Z. I'll patch the config and kick a backfill job.
oliver: Please also add a temporary alert for joiner.validation_errors > 50/min to catch regressions.
devex-anna: I'll roll the flag now and start the backfill. ETA for backfill of 40m of data ~ 12-18 minutes.
maya: Told customer we have a plan and will re-index missing spans; they appreciate the update.

sre-jun: After backfill confirm by running the earlier span query. If spans reappear, mark incident resolved and note root cause: schema change + skipped canary.
oliver: I'll open a short postmortem and add remediation: require canary for schema changes and add automated schema-compat tests. Assigning to @sre-jun for remediation. :memo:
maya: Customer will verify once backfill completes. I'll follow up here with their confirmation. :thumbsup:
